name: Isracard Ltd.
summary: Isracard Ltd. operates as a credit card company in Israel. It offers various payment solutions, including Digital credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Garmin Pay, Topcash, and Isracard application, as well as commercial credit and debit card clearing. The company also offers credit and finance services; and issuance of debit and settlement cards; as well discounting and settlement services for the debit card brands, such as Isracard, MasterCard, American Express, and Visa. Isracard Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Bnei Brak, Israel.
